table.purpose: Single size for header, habit names and entries; font family inherited from Obsidian.

components.name: Entry Cell (completed)
components.description: A completed habit entry: green fill with a white check.
components.css: .ds-entry { padding: 18px 12px; text-align: center; color: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); transition: background-color 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-completed { background-color: #4caf50; } .ds-entry:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--background-modifier-border, #888); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Entry Cell (failed)
components.description: A failed habit entry: red fill with a white x-circle.
components.css: .ds-entry { padding: 18px 12px; text-align: center; color: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); transition: background-color 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-failed { background-color: #f44336; } .ds-entry:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--background-modifier-border, #888); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Entry Cell (skipped)
components.description: A skipped habit entry: blue fill with a white minus-circle.
components.css: .ds-entry { padding: 18px 12px; text-align: center; color: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); transition: background-color 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-skip { background-color: #64b5f6; } .ds-entry:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--background-modifier-border, #888); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Date Control
components.description: 48px square button for moving the visible date range.
components.html: <button class="ds-date-control" aria-label="Previous"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-date-control { width: 48px; height: 48px; background-color: rgba(128,128,128,0.2); border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border, #888); border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); cursor: pointer; color: inherit; } .ds-date-control:hover { background-color: rgba(128,128,128,0.08); transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; }

narrative.overview: Tiny Habits lives inside someone else's house. Obsidian owns the theme, the fonts, the radii, and the surfaces; the plugin borrows them through Obsidian's CSS variables and adds only what the host cannot supply: three status colors for habit entries.
keyCharacteristics: Host-themed: every neutral, border, radius, and font comes from Obsidian variables.
Three plugin-owned colors, all for entry status.
Flat: no shadows; depth comes from translucency and a 6px gap between cells.
Keyboard-first: focus is visible and the cells are the interaction targets.

rules.name: The Host First Rule
rules.body: If Obsidian already has a variable for it, use the variable. Add a plugin-owned color only for entry status.

rules.name: The Status Is Fill Rule
rules.body: Entry status is carried by cell fill and an icon, never by text color.

rules.name: The Flat Cell Rule
rules.body: Cells never get shadows or gradients; hover changes opacity only.

dos: Do use Obsidian variables for surfaces, borders, text, radii, and fonts.
Do keep the three status colors identical in every theme, with a white icon on top.
Do keep a visible focus outline on entry cells for keyboard users.
Do keep the small-screen rule: last date column only at 768px and below.
donts: Don't hard-code a neutral color, font, or radius the host already provides.
Don't add shadows, gradients, or decorative borders to cells.
Don't signal status with color alone; keep the icon.
Don't introduce a fourth status color without a new entry status.
